items.title: No sign of larger hantavirus outbreak, says UN health agency
items.description: The situation could still change and there might be more confirmed cases, warns the head of the World Health Organization.

items.title: Trump says Iran ceasefire is on 'massive life support'
items.description: The US president criticises an Iranian counteroffer to end the war, and says the month-long ceasefire is "unbelievably weak".

items.title: Lebanon says two paramedics among 13 killed in Israeli strikes
items.description: Lebanon's health ministry says the paramedics were carrying out a rescue mission in Nabatieh in response to an earlier attack that killed one person.

items.title: Zelensky's ex-chief of staff in court as Ukraine corruption probe escalates
items.description: Andriy Yermak was named by Ukraine's two anti-corruption agencies as a suspect in a money-laundering scheme.

items.title: US inflation jumps to 3.8% as energy costs surge from Iran war
items.description: The key measure of US inflation rises its highest level since May 2023 as consumers feel the impact of the Iran war.

items.title: Hamas 'weaponised' sexual violence in 7 October attacks, Israeli investigation says
items.description: The most comprehensive report of its kind details harrowing cases of sexual attacks which it says were systematic.

items.title: Dali ship operator charged over deadly  Baltimore bridge collapse
items.description: Six construction workers were killed and several vehicles plunged into the river after the cargo ship crashed into the bridge.

items.title: eBay rejects $55.5bn offer from GameStop
items.description: The online auction giant said it doubted how the video game retailer would finance its offer.

items.title: Uganda's president sworn in for record seventh term
items.description: Yoweri Museveni, 81, won disputed elections in January to extend his 40-year rule.

items.title: South Africa's top court bars repeat asylum applications
items.description: The home affairs minister hails the ruling as a "victory" against the "abuse" of the refugee system.

items.title: EU needs to delay social media access for children - von der Leyen
items.description: She told an EU summit that an expert panel was due to come up with steps on how to protect minors online by July.

items.title: Mexico cancels plans to end school year early for World Cup
items.description: Parents were angry at a proposal to end classes on 5 June instead of 15 July due to the tournament and expected extreme heat.
